bot.title: Rates in Telegram
bot.text: Send the bot “100 usd” and it converts to somoni right away. Every morning at 9:00 it sends the new rate.

footer.source: Official rates and bank rates come from the National Bank of Tajikistan website (nbt.tj), with their own update time.
footer.independent: Independent project, not affiliated with the National Bank or any bank. No cookies, no analytics.

settings.installHow: iPhone: in Safari tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Android: browser menu → “Install app”.
